future_check: selfcheck-minimal-impostor is expected and lawful because its accepted classes are executable edge cases: the exact 8x10 empty texture, exact 8x10 all_five texture, and a pure 2x2/2x3/3x2 n_rooms=1,n_tips=0 room. Nearest malformed controls (singleton, domino, L-triomino, two singletons, solid 3x3, bent arm, plus arm, overlong arm, and 3+ components) reject.; The strict prior uses translated extracted official bitmaps by design, so a learner could over-specialize to those anchors. It is limited to about 25%; the other about 75% uses a generalized room/bridge/straight-arm/T-cap constructor. This residual risk keeps distribution coverage and training suitability at tier 3 rather than 4.; The uniform degenerate permission is intentionally narrow: only the fixed 8x10 empty/all-five layouts pass. Other in-envelope uniform sizes now reject.; Pure n_rooms=1,n_tips=0 outputs contain cyan but no red by design. They are explicit override/texture edges, not normal defaults; 15,000 post-repair default draws contained both red and cyan.; The complete linked-profile rate is reported from the returned grid, not marginal ranges: main 3629/15000 and disjoint 3719/15000. Cross-profile red/cyan recombinations reject in the focused regression.
rationale: VERSION 3.2.0 -> 3.3.0; canonical Racket rule and synchronized source records unchanged; two-component generalized mode now requires at least two deliberate tips, removing 372/10000 sampled easy+medium normal grids whose output had no red branch; self_check now distinguishes the exact fixed uniform textures, requires both answer colors for ordinary grids, and validates residual thin components as straight 1..3 runs or the held-out T-cap; generalized construction now emits T-caps that consume exactly two degree-1 tips, covering the distinctive held-out topology outside the translated canonical prior; profile_signature(grid) records the full linked tuple (h,w,components,rooms,tips,red,cyan), and the canonical builder now checks the entire tuple before returning; focused regressions cover all canonical pairs, two seed ranges, cross-profile recombination rejection, malformed pseudo-arms, and narrow edge-case handling
summary: A gray(5) blob is made of 2x2 'rooms' joined by 1-wide arms. Tip arms: a degree-1 cell grows a straight 3-cell run toward its only neighbor. Bridge arms: an uncovered thin cell (in no 2x2) grows a 3-cell run toward a thick (in-2x2) neighbor, tie-break up/left/down/right. Arm cells recolor to red(2) — including room cells the run overlaps; all other gray cells recolor to cyan(8).
